name: Product School Community

sources.title: Slack community landing — 100k+ PMs, free join via email; channel list includes #11_product-launches

requirements: Free — join with an email address (or 'Get started free' account at app.productschool.com)
Audience is product managers — the pitch must be relevant to PMs
Self-promotion belongs in designated channels — #11_product-launches exists for launches; spamming other channels violates community norms
preparation: A short launch message tailored to product managers for #11_product-launches
Product link and any PM-relevant angle (roadmap, feedback, beta invites)
workflow: Accept the Slack invite and join product-school.slack.com
Post the launch in #11_product-launches; engage in AMAs/feedback channels for real reach
Optional: #10_feedback-n-surveys for feedback asks, local channels for networking
watchFor: No public/indexable web surface — Slack posts are not a backlink and not crawlable
Counts-as-live is only verifiable inside the Slack workspace
The community is PM-centric; off-topic products will get no traction
Slack free-tier message history limits may bury a launch post quickly
countsAsLive: The launch post exists in #11_product-launches inside the product-school.slack.com workspace — not publicly verifiable
unknowns: Current moderation/self-promotion rules inside the Slack
Whether an approval step sits between email signup and the Slack invite
